comment: If you want to grow intellectually, take any one of his classes. If you want an easy class, do not. Take good notes. And tests aren't as difficult as others say (or at least not anymore). He's moving to BYU next semester; you guys are lucky.

Prof. Givens makes sure to include numerous perspectives on the topic and is unbiased when lecturing. Unannounced pop quizzes sometimes. Participation and the final paper are a large percentage of the grade.  Prof. Givens is brilliant and could answer any question you have, and he is always available if you need help. Wish I could take it again.

If you participate, read the assigned readings carefully (they're lengthy), and write down every detail from lectures, you should be fine. Get a jump start on the big essay, because he grades tough on it. The midterm isn't bad, but the final is really hard, so make sure to go over everything from the course.

His tests are entirely lecture based. Always came into class and learned something new, I was hardly ever bored in class. This class in particular would be somewhat challenging for those with little previous knowledge about the Bible and religion.

Professor Givens is incredibly smart in anything relating to the Bible. He is very helpful if you ask for it, and is very clear on his explanations. This class is very interesting and I loved it, but it is a ton of information and the tests are pretty difficult and based a lot off of lecture.
Best teacher ever! You learn something new every single class. You really have to apply yourself and be open minded to everything he brings up. This class can really be life changing.

Best teacher I've ever had. you'll hate him the first week just cause he's so damn smart. but his midterms and finals are actually kinda easy if you pay attention in class. and he's good about being available for essay help outside of class. overall he's not an easy teacher, but his classes are worth the effort.

He is an amazing professor. He will push you hard, but at the end of the day you will have learn something new and see things with a new perspective. It is worth taking him if you want to challenge yourself and learn. However if you are not a strong writer, it will hurt your grade.

Literally best teacher I have ever had in my entire life. Extremely inspiring and sets out to make "life worth living" with his lectures and his devotion to the humanities. This man made me consider being a professor for the first time in my life and made me understand so much about life. Take this teacher, dont complain about difficulty and enjoy!
Givens is ridiculously smart and interesting, but also grades extremely hard and won't like any thesis he didn't write himself. have funnn
condescending professor; does not define expectations clearly

great teacher until the grading comes in to the picture. shows up 5min late every class unless he's giving a quiz. didn't give a mid-term...? and the final did not relate to any of the lectures...yeah the lectures are good but unless ur intrested and able to get a word in with the Bible aficionados ur grade will suffer.

AMAZING teacher. He will literally change your life. If you dont mind getting a B then take his classes. A's ARE possible, but youll have to work hard. I wouldnt care if I failed his class though. Hail Lord Givens!
A great teacher, but he grades hard.

Excellent teacher with encyclopedic knowledge of Romanticism and the Romantic period. Able to mix contemporary and historical refs. Makes topics accessible to those unfamiliar with them. Has high standards but is very helpful if you talk to or email him directly. Would another class with him in a heartbeat.

If there were one person to beat Ken Jennings on Jeopardy, it would be this man. His lectures are interesting but don't be surprised if you never get above a C on a paper or if your class's midterm average is a 68%. You need to have an incredibly deep understanding of literature if you want to do well.
Extremely demanding but such a worth while experience. I left his class thinking, "This is why I came to college."

The best professor i have ever had in my entire life. He is incredibly smart and teaches the material extremely well. If you do the reading and try hard he will make it more than worth your while. I would try and take any class that Givens teaches, he is just that good.

This class ****ing sucks.  Hes really knowledgeable which makes the class a little less boring but he has a very quiet manner and hes scary as****!!!.  He grades really hard on the paper but the tests aren't so bad. Do the reading or youre screwed for quizzes.  Avoid this guy like the plague.
sublimely difficult.  co taught with russell - they competed to see who could grade harder.  frightening final.  I wet my pants.

I ended up loving Givens (and making an A, it is possible!) because he actually did make me like poetry I gen. hate.  Don't go in with the belief that what he says will be above your head, and you will learn & enjoy it.  Also--why is everyone so unwilling to risk a bad great for a great experience??

The only Eng. major class that I remember people failing.  It was 5 yrs. ago, but I know it was hard for me.  I was used to my grade being determined by my effort, but I struggled for a B.  He was my advisor and recommended that I take 19 hrs my 1st semester of college . . . crazy!  good but hard
Don't take Bible & Lit if you're an idiot or a lazy ass.  If you actually pay attention and do the reading, you can't get below a B.  Dr. Givens ROCKS.
SOOOO SMART Hard to please but he wont tank your GPA
most horrible experience i have ever had

This was the most difficult, most boring class I took while at UR.  When I approached Dr. Givens for help on where I should start my paper, he looked at me, smirked, and said "I suggest you start at the library."  Way too imperious and self-sati
He challenges his students, and he sincerely wants everyone to learn as much as possible.  He also gave me valuable advice on what is important in life.
this is a great class, if you like being bored and having no chance of getting above a C.
For a man who's barely five feet tall he is amazingly intimidating.  Worth taking just to soak up some of his intelligence even if your grade does suck.
Hardest class I've ever taken... but he is extremely smart. He did extend the deadlines to some papers but was brutal in grading them. If he disagrees w your thesis, good luck!

Ridiculously hard- an amazingly difficult grader, has no writing fellows, and is unwilling to allow rewrites. With papers- he is vague and unforgiving- and although a GENIUS, he speaks of things far above any of the students heads...hurting our grade.

Brilliant professor and extremely enjoyable class.  I learned more about English in that class than in all four years of HS.  Strongly recommend his class, but only if you are intelligent and want to learn--freeloaders need not apply.
It was the most brutal class I have ever been in.  There is no room for error in his class.  Be prepared to work your butt off just for a C
needs to realize the world doesn't revolve around his class
No Comments
He's very intelligent, but is sometimes over the top.
